# Reception Perception: The Show — 2024-01-18

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/reception-perception/2024-01-18-rp-college-standouts-nfl-divisional-round-preview.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

Second [[Matt Harmon]] episode ingested, with co-host **James Koh** (not
tracked; ASR renders his name "James Coe" here). Two distinct halves:

**Half one — early 2024 draft-prospect charting.** Harmon breaks his normal
schedule (he usually starts charting prospects in spring) to give early,
explicitly-caveated 3-game-sample Reception Perception reads on the
consensus top three 2024 receiver prospects: [[Marvin Harrison Jr.]],
[[Malik Nabers]], and a new page, [[Rome Odunze]] (ASR: "Romo Dunze"/"Romo
Dunzey," normalized to his real name). This is the fullest on-air
demonstration yet of Harmon's charting methodology — captured as a
substantial expansion to [[Reception Perception Methodology]], including the
first mention of his cross-class "stacked board" and its top-10-worthy
"tier-one" grade (applied here to update [[Ja'Marr Chase]] and
[[Drake London]]).

**Half two — NFL Divisional Round preview.** Game-by-game breakdown of all
four Divisional Round matchups (Houston-Baltimore, Green Bay-San Francisco,
Tampa Bay-Detroit, Kansas City-Buffalo), heavy on betting lines and player
props. Per the low-durability guidance for game-recap/preview content, only
forward-looking evaluative reads and specific matchup mechanisms were
ingested (coverage-shell stats, target-share context, injury notes) rather
than play-by-play or odds themselves. Two new Houston depth-chart pages
created off real, if modest, evaluative content: [[John Metchie III]] and
[[Xavier Hutchinson]] (ASR: "John Mechie," normalized).

**Not given pages** (mentioned, no substantive standalone evaluative take):
Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes (turnover-rate/zone-vs-man stat call-outs, but
framed as single-game matchup betting context rather than a durable player
read), Baker Mayfield (one-line pressure-susceptibility mention), Robert
Woods (snap-share context only), L'Jarius Sneed and Trent McDuffie (defensive
players, out of scope). A Bill Belichick/Deion-Sanders coaching aside from
the first half of the show and various player-prop betting lines were **not**
ingested as wiki content.
